restart.body: Adopted stacks get Coaming's ownership labels on their first deploy. A label change recreates the container, which restarts it briefly. They're listed under Ownership labels only.
restart.body_standalone: Adopted stacks get Coaming's ownership labels on their first deploy. A label change recreates the containers, which restarts them briefly. They're listed under Ownership labels only.

group.title: Ownership labels only
group.sub_one: {{count}} service will be recreated to take Coaming ownership labels (brief restart). Nothing else about it changes.
group.sub_other: {{count}} services will be recreated to take Coaming ownership labels (brief restart). Nothing else about them changes.
group.sub_standalone_one: {{count}} container will be recreated to take Coaming ownership labels (brief restart). Nothing else about it changes.
group.sub_standalone_other: {{count}} containers will be recreated to take Coaming ownership labels (brief restart). Nothing else about them changes.
group.caption: Labels on {{service}}
group.standaloneNote: Compose recreates the container because Coaming's labels change its configuration hash. No setting you wrote changes.

banner.title: {{name}} is adopted but not yet deployed by Coaming
banner.body_one: The first deploy adds Coaming's ownership labels and recreates {{count}} service (brief restart). Review shows exactly what changes.
banner.body_other: The first deploy adds Coaming's ownership labels and recreates {{count}} services (brief restart). Review shows exactly what changes.
banner.body_standalone_one: The first deploy adds Coaming's ownership labels and recreates {{count}} container (brief restart). Review shows exactly what changes.
banner.body_standalone_other: The first deploy adds Coaming's ownership labels and recreates {{count}} containers (brief restart). Review shows exactly what changes.
banner.bodyUnknown: The first deploy adds Coaming's ownership labels and recreates its services (brief restart). Review shows exactly what changes.
